source: Live TallyPrime Silver 7.1 read of the synthetic company BRIDGE AMEND LAB through the raw serial sender of a lab sitting that made reads only: no import and no write
request_rendered_by: ReadOnlyProfile::StandardLedgerCatalogV2 { company }.render() (V1's request plus the one NativeMethod line IsBillWiseOn)
content: The import family's ledger catalogue (design E of #1234): 19 ledgers (the book has grown since its 27 Sep capture: 14 then) with name, GUID, parent, the company GUID and name computes, and ISBILLWISEON on every row (4 Yes, 15 No). Three ledger names end in a carriage return and line feed and carry a flag like the rest.
provenance_limit: One synthetic book on one build, read once (not a paired read). It shows how Tally answers this request for these shapes; it is not evidence about a client's book or a large book. The book has been written to since the V1 capture of the same name, so its ledgers differ from that capture.
sensitivity_review: Synthetic BRIDGE company, synthetic ledger names and GUIDs; no client, GSTIN, address or credential.
